transcript.text: Hello! How can I assist you with Department of Labor services today?
I need to cancel my Department of Labor appointment.

To prevent fraudulent cancellation, I cannot cancel your appointment directly. You must speak with a Department of Labor representative to complete this request. If you have a confirmation number, I can look up your appointment details and transfer you to an agent.

I found your appointment details. You have an appointment scheduled for December 1, 2026, at 2:00 PM at the Albany location. The reason for the appointment is an intake interview. I will now transfer you to a representative to assist with your cancellation request.
